mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing beautiful clear skies with a temperature of 82 degrees, feeling like 85, near the Verona Public Library. Tonight, under a waxing crescent moon, we will have a clear view of the International Space Station passing over starting at 9:31 PM.

In local news, Verona continues its push toward sustainability. Apartment residents can drop off their food waste at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the city has successfully integrated green transportation initiatives, including anti-idling technology on its new ambulance and earning recognition as a Bicycle Friendly Community.

There are plenty of local events coming up soon, including live music at Bailey's Run and the Mount Horeb Art Fair on July 19th. Looking ahead, you can check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday, July 22nd, at Hometown Junction Park.

In the police report, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle collision on Old PB at Whalen Road last Friday morning. A 24-year-old bicyclist from Oshkosh sustained minor injuries, and a 49-year-old Verona driver was cited for failing to yield the right of way.

Over at Culver's, today's flavor of the day is the classic Turtle, featuring rich caramel and pecans. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to get your scoop before they close. Tomorrow's featured flavor will be Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
